Name: Item bag for Cape Stardew
Author: spritelessG
Description: I like a good dungeon crawl. But if you add too many you get more items than the normal stardew inventory can handle. So I made this bag to help with the items from Cape Stardew.

Downloads.Description: Just put it in ItemBags/assets/Modded Bags

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it contains files, but none of them are manifest.json.
